hook: Why did we build speed chess as a Telegram Mini App
text:
Why did we build speed chess as a Telegram Mini App

Opening a desktop browser and typing logins takes 3 minutes.
In Telegram, challenging a friend takes 1 tap.

Sub-100ms WebSockets. Zero app store downloads. Pure blitz.
